text:
Alex: Heads-up — seeing a ~7% median latency regression on the MQA paged-KV path after the kernel-autotune merge last night. Traces point to more frequent fallback to the 'paged_block_v2' kernel for seqlen 256-512. Attaching sample logs.
Maya: ack. which job/cluster did you run this on? :eyes:
Alex: q-synthetic-03 (A100s), can repro on local dev with a small harness. Here's the relevant snippet from the runtime picker logs:
```
KERNEL_PICKER: seqlen=320 model=bert-mqa hw=A100 kernel=paged_block_v2 score=0.78 fallback_to=paged_block_v1 reason=kv_fragmentation
KERNEL_PICKER: batching=dynamic batch_size=8 est_latency=14.3ms kernel=paged_block_v2
```
Sam: hmm. We expected autotune to prefer v1 at that seqlen for MQA because v2 had worse memory prefetch for our KV layout. Did the autotune weight change? 
Linh: I looked at the autotune history: the scoring weight for prefetch_cost was decreased in the merge (commit 4f7e3b). That made the score favor v2 due to slightly better compute throughput, but v2's prefetch pattern thrashes the paged KV LRU so tail latency jumps.
Maya: can we confirm with perf counters? e.g., DRAM reads / cache misses on paged-kv pages. I can run perf sampling. 
Alex: ran a quick perf tool: cache miss rate on seqlen 320 increased ~2.4x for v2 vs v1. Also saw higher GPU memcpy stalls. Logs:
```
PERF: paged_block_v2 dram_reads=1.8e6 l2_miss=4.2e5 memcpy_stalls=120ms
PERF: paged_block_v1 dram_reads=8.5e5 l2_miss=1.7e5 memcpy_stalls=48ms
```
Sam: ok that aligns. Short-term: rollback the autotune delta or add a rule: if kernel==paged_block_v2 and kv_fragmentation>0.6 then prefer v1. 
Linh: +1. Also think we should tweak the autotuner cost function to include a KV-fragmentation penalty term. Right now it's just compute and raw memory but not page-level locality.
Maya: I can add a quick guard in the selector by EOD and run canary across q-synthetic-01/02 to validate. If perf-bot agrees, we can ship. 
perf-bot: bench/q-synthetic-03: before=13.1ms median after=14.0ms median (+6.9%), p99 before=48ms after=56ms (+16.7%). Regression correlates with autotune merge 4f7e3b.
Alex: thanks. Action items: 1) Maya to add selector guard (target: canary). 2) Linh to propose autotune objective update (page-locality penalty). 3) Sam to prepare rollback patch if canary fails. I'll update incident doc if rollout expands. 
Sam: for rollback, let's make it a config flag so we can flip without deploy.
Maya: will send PR shortly. I'll post canary results here. :thumbsup:
Alex: Great — also let's add a microbenchmark measuring kv-fragmentation vs blocksize; I suspect blocksz 64->128 changes fragmentation wall. Short test plan in case useful:
- run kv-pager-sim with blocksz in [32,64,128,256]
- measure avg pages accessed and kernel pick distribution
- profile l2_miss / memcpy_stalls
Linh: will run the sim overnight and upload CSV.
perf-bot: perf-capture uploaded: gs://redwood-perf/pagedkv/2990012345/raw.tar.gz
Alex: perfect — thanks everyone. Keeping this thread for canary updates.
